speaker: george_bryan
text: The court has been at Whitehall since Saturday. They ran at tilt on Saturday, and yesterday they tourneyed. Tonight the gentlemen of Gray's Inn carry a masque of Proteus and a rock of adamant before the Queen.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Does anyone speak in it?

speaker: george_bryan
text: A masque is a show, Sam. They come in disguised, and they dance, and sometimes they speak. Sometimes the speaking is the least of it. Tonight, if anyone speaks, it is their speaking. A rock comes on with their Proteus. Adamant, they call the rock. I am telling thee what it is. I am not inviting thee to it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I would like to see a rock come on. A rock has no line to forget, and a yard would know what to do with it. They will wheel it, or they will carry it. Either way it is a thing, and we are not to see the thing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is asked to this one. It is heard of only. Thou wouldst like the rock, Dick, and the liking is the end of it. The same Prince as the barges. He dined with the Mayor. He landed at the Tower. Tonight he is theirs. We are still in this yard.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The scholars play before the Queen for nothing, and we play before the scholars for a penny. Who's the fool?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fool is the man who goes where he is not asked. We played here. The Duke is back on the peg. I am not dressing him for Whitehall, and I am not sending a boy to look at a door.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I was at Somerset House, waiting on my lord's clerk. The warrant for December's twenty pounds is drawn and moving. That is the news I waited for. It is not the coin. Nobody is to fetch it tonight, and nobody is to spend it in talk.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: If it is moving, where does it arrive? A thing that moves ought to come to a hand. I have waited for worse things than money, and they arrived.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is going through clerks, Sam. That is a country where a boy can wait a long time. Thou art not to spend it. I am not to spend it. John is not in this room to write it down, and I will not write it for him.

speaker: george_bryan
text: My lord's word, with the warrant, is to stop cleanly on Shrove Tuesday and hand the Mayor no stick. We play tomorrow. We do not play on Wednesday. The word is the stopping. It is not a quarrel about who else keeps open.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then tomorrow is the last of this house, and the rock can have the Queen without our help. Thou wilt not go, Will. I heard thee. I am agreeing, which I dislike. I am agreeing because a stick in the Mayor's hand is a duller thing than a rock.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A penny. I said a penny, and I meant the scholars' penny. I did not mean our supper, and I did not mean the Queen's twenty pounds. Let the twenty pounds move. Movement is not payment. I have been paid in movement, and it bought no ale.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Do they wear ruffs in a masque? I can picture a rock. I cannot picture the gentlemen, and a ruff is the part I understand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No ruffs of ours. We are not going. Thou mayst picture a rock. Thou mayst not say we were invited. Heard of is the whole of it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You have it right, Master Shakespeare. I will not improve a hearing into an invitation by telling it twice. The tilt was Saturday. The tourney was yesterday. The masque is tonight. We were at none of them. I was at Somerset House, which is a clerk's stair, and not a revel.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The afternoon was ours. Two Gentlemen, and the gown, and a yard that knew when to be quiet. I am not giving the afternoon to a rock I have not seen. Thou playedst the Duke as a man who means to be obeyed. Leave it there. Do not improve him at supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will leave him there. The name is enough, and I am not bringing a speech out to be admired. Tomorrow is the comedy again, the last time before the ashes. Thou wilt be in the yard at nine, Dick. Not at Whitehall, and not late.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nine in the yard, then. I am not singing tonight for anyone's feast, and I am not bringing a new tally to the morning. The old count can sit where it sits. The Duke did not need my help, and the Queen has scholars enough.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good. Leave the old count where it is. My lord asked for a clean stop, not a new song, and not a walk to the Mayor. Twenty pounds, drawn and moving. I will say it again, because a boy can spend a sentence if you leave it shining.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I will not spend it. I asked where a moving thing arrives. If the answer is nowhere tonight, I can carry nowhere. It is lighter than a rock, and it does not need a ruff.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nowhere tonight. Thou hast it, Sam. Bryan waited on the clerk so the rest of us need not wait on a door. I am for home. The house will ask which queen. I mean to answer before the question grows a sleeve.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go, then. Thou art hardly needed to keep us from Whitehall. A shut gate will do that work. Kemp, leave the penny where you set it. It was a good bitterness, and it does not need a second telling.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One telling is enough when it is true. The scholars play for nothing. We play for a penny. I know which I was this afternoon, and I know which I am not tonight. You may all go home sober. I am going as far as the ale that is already poured, and no farther than this inn.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Home is the right end of it. Tomorrow we stop cleanly. I will not carry a stick, and I will not carry a story that we were at the masque. Sam, if anyone asks thee, say we heard of it. Heard of is the whole truth, and for once it is short.
